meta.src:
schema: playbook/2
name: solution_aTFrQkQDgvp7m17er_playbook_abx60
title: CASE Evaluation (Automated)
description: >
  Evaluates CASE when TI and correlation complete; runs rules engine, then conditionally triggers AI analysis if no rules match.
actions:
  Run_Rules_Engine_Against_Current_CASE_Record:
    meta: {}
    title: Run Rules Engine Against Current CASE Record
    type: connector
    delay: 0
    pool: $default
    on-success:
    - Determine_Rule_Match_azt2g: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: Executes rules engine component against the current CASE record using its tracking ID to determine matching rules.
    action: $playbook.component_aZzBN7D0j0KWVIPdU_playbook
    asset: ""
    environment: {}
    inputs:
      CASE_Tracking_ID: "{ $:ref: $event.data.record.values['tracking-id'] }"
    testInputs: {}
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 05ecab24-e3ee-45dc-94d3-418d7da68e2e
  Determine_Rule_Match_azt2g:
    meta: {}
    title: Determine Rule Match
    type: transformation
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    on-success:
    - If_No_Rule_Match_a3opj: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: >
      Evaluates whether any rules matched by checking if Records_Matched count is greater than zero.
    transformations:
      rule_matched:
        title: Rule Matched
        inputs:
          data:
            actions:
              Run_Rules_Engine_Against_Current_SIG_Record:
                result:
                  published:
                    Records_Matched:
                      $:ref: $actions.Run_Rules_Engine_Against_Current_CASE_Record.result.published.Records_Matched
              Run_Rules_Engine_Against_Current_CASE_Record:
                result:
                  published:
                    Records_Matched:
                      $:ref: $actions.Run_Rules_Engine_Against_Current_CASE_Record.result.published.Records_Matched
          expression: '$count(actions.Run_Rules_Engine_Against_Current_CASE_Record.result.published.Records_Matched) > 0 ? true : false'
        next: ""
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
        actionType: jsonata
    entrypoint: rule_matched
  Initial_AI_CASE_Analysis_a0cpz:
    meta: {}
    title: Initial AI CASE Analysis
    type: connector
    delay: 0
    pool: $default
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: >
      Performs AI-powered analysis of the CASE record when no automated rules match the CASE characteristics.
    action: $playbook.component_aYiOngFvwb7Vj2kOT_playbook
    asset: ""
    environment: {}
    inputs:
      CASE_Record_Tracking_ID: "{ $:ref: $event.data.record.values['tracking-id'] }"
    testInputs: {}
  If_No_Rule_Match_a3opj:
    meta: {}
    title: If No Rule Match
    type: conditional
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: Conditionally triggers AI analysis when rules engine finds no matching rules for the CASE.
    inputSchemaReferenceId: ai0a3
    conditions:
    - action: upsertRecord
      condition:
        $:and:
        - - $:ref: $actions.Determine_Rule_Match_azt2g.result.rule_matched
          - $:eq: false
    else: ""
  upsertRecord:
    meta: {}
    title: Update the Rule-Match
    type: recordAction
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    on-success:
    - Initial_AI_CASE_Analysis_a0cpz: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: ""
    inputs:
      applicationId: aGLUPEw5Z3dKNx0wk
      patchValues:
        rule-matched: No Matching Rules
      restrictions:
        groups:
          operation: append
          value: []
        users:
          operation: append
          value: []
      trackingId: "{ $:ref: $event.data.record.values['tracking-id'] }"
      applicationName: ""
      removeValues: {}
      appendValues: {}
    recordActionType: patch
    inputSchemaReferenceId: e95ef390-61df-42a8-be2e-9402ec47d8ec
triggers:
  records:
  - aokgp:
      if:
        $:and:
        - - $:ref: $event.data.record.values['threat-intelligence-status']
          - $:eq: Complete
          - ignoreCase: false
        - - $:ref: $event.data.record.values['correlation-status']
          - $:eq: Complete
          - ignoreCase: false
        - $:or:
          - - $:ref: $event.data.previous.values['threat-intelligence-status']
            - $:neq: Complete
            - ignoreCase: false
          - - $:ref: $event.data.previous.values['correlation-status']
            - $:neq: Complete
            - ignoreCase: false
entrypoints:
- Run_Rules_Engine_Against_Current_CASE_Record
meta:
  enabled: true
namespace: $default
pool: ""
timeout: 0
publish: {}
environment: {}
inputs:
  type: object

If_No_Rule_Match_a3opj.description: Conditionally triggers AI analysis when rules engine finds no matching rules for the CASE.
